dialogues.jp: ゴトゴト……。
ゴトゴト……。
ゴトゴト……。
（なんだ？）
２階から物音が聞こえてくる。
萌先輩が何か、やっているのか。

テレビのスイッチを切ると、今は静かな二階へ
と向かう。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、朝倉くん」

廊下に出たところで、ばったりと萌先輩に会う。
もしかして、さっきの音は先輩じゃなかった？
dialogues.en:
When I got to the hallway, I bumped into Moe-sempai. Perhaps
she wasn't the one who was making all that noise.
dialogues.text:
When I got to the hallway, I bumped into Moe-sempai. Perhaps
she wasn't the one who was making all that noise.

dialogues.jp: 「先輩、上でなんかやってました？」
dialogues.en: "Were you just doing something up here?"
dialogues.text: "Were you just doing something up here?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「お部屋の整理です。まだちゃんと片付けてい
　ませんでしたから」
dialogues.en: "I was organizing the room. I haven't cleaned it up yet."
dialogues.text: "I was organizing the room. I haven't cleaned it up yet."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、なるほど」
確かに、まだ箱に入ったままのとかあったよな。
dialogues.en: She still had something in her box.
dialogues.text: She still had something in her box.

dialogues.jp: 「手伝いますよ」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、大丈夫ですから」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「遠慮しなくていいですよ。ひとりよりもふた
　りでやったほうが早いですから」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to be hesitant. It's quicker to finish it
with two people than one."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to be hesitant. It's quicker to finish it
with two people than one."

dialogues.jp: 先輩を促すように階段へと向かう。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……すみません……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。まあ重い物とかは運べませんけどね」
dialogues.en:
"No problem. I won't be able to lift heavy things,
though..."
dialogues.text:
"No problem. I won't be able to lift heavy things,
though..."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩に手伝ってもらいながら、階段を上って
いく。
dialogues.en: I went up the stairs with Moe-sempai supporting me.
dialogues.text: I went up the stairs with Moe-sempai supporting me.

dialogues.jp:
（……なんか女の子の服を触るのってドキドキ
　するな）
dialogues.en: (......I feel nervous touching a girl's clothes......)
dialogues.text: (......I feel nervous touching a girl's clothes......)

dialogues.jp:
そびえ立つようにして重ねられた衣類に囲まれ
ながら、それらをタンスにしまっていく。
dialogues.en:
I was surrounded by her clothing as I put them into the
wardrobe.
dialogues.text:
I was surrounded by her clothing as I put them into the
wardrobe.

dialogues.jp: 役得とは……こういう状況をいうのかな。
dialogues.en: I guess this is one of my side benefits......
dialogues.text: I guess this is one of my side benefits......

dialogues.jp: （結構、楽しいかも）
◆荷物整理◆
萌先輩は、やたらと荷物を持っている人だった。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai brought so many things to my house.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai brought so many things to my house.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩一人ではとても終わりそうもなく、俺も、
荷物整理を手伝う事にしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
I decided to help organize her stuff because it'd take a
long time for her to finish it by herself.
dialogues.text:
I decided to help organize her stuff because it'd take a
long time for her to finish it by herself.
